evals.name: lisbon-two-days
evals.prompt: My sister sent me a travel article about Lisbon — I saved the text at /home/user/Recipes/.claude/skills/travel-itinerary-workspace/files/lisbon-article.txt. We're going in October. Can you turn it into a day-by-day itinerary and make me one of those files I can import into Google My Maps so it shows up on my phone? A phone-friendly page of the plan would be great too.
evals.expected_output: A valid KML file with 2 day folders matching the article's Day One/Day Two structure, ~13 stops all named in the article with coordinates inside Lisbon, tips carried into pin descriptions; an itinerary JSON; a phone-friendly HTML page; My Maps import instructions.
assertions: KML file exists and parses as valid XML in the KML 2.2 namespace
All pins fall inside Lisbon's bounding box
Every pin names a place from the source article (nothing invented)
Pin descriptions carry a Google Maps link
KML has exactly 2 day folders (layers)
At least 10 pins (article coverage)
A phone-friendly HTML itinerary page with an interactive map exists
Reply gives Google My Maps import instructions (mymaps.google.com + Import)

evals.name: rome-espresso-walk
evals.prompt: ok i pasted this listicle about coffee bars in rome into /home/user/Recipes/.claude/skills/travel-itinerary-workspace/files/rome-coffee.txt. its not day-by-day, just a list of 8 places. can u still make me a walking map out of it? i want the google my maps import file + google maps links for each spot

assertions: KML file exists and parses as valid XML in the KML 2.2 namespace
All pins fall inside Rome's bounding box
Every pin names a place from the source article (nothing invented)
Pin descriptions carry a Google Maps link
Exactly 8 pins — nothing dropped, nothing padded
Stop order walks shorter than the article's listing order
A phone-friendly HTML itinerary page with an interactive map exists
Reply gives Google My Maps import instructions (mymaps.google.com + Import)
